name: giant octopus
desc: Giant Octopus is a CR 1 beast.

actions.name: water breathing
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: underwater camouflage
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

actions.name: hold breath
actions.desc: While out of water, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can hold its breath for 1 hour.

actions.name: tentacles
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. The target is &Reference[grappled] (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is &reference[restrained], and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't use its [[lookup @item.name lowercase]] on another target.

actions.name: ink cloud
actions.desc: A [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=iuQ878Y9dLNBjNXU]] cloud of ink extends all around the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} if it is underwater. The area is &reference[heavily obscured] for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink. After releasing the ink, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use the &reference[Dash] action as a bonus action.
